notes.title: ⌛Hexed Time: Update & Bugfixes ✨
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

First off, a huge thank you to everyone who's played Hexed Time, left a review, or shared your thoughts—your support means the world! 💜 I published Hexed Time hoping it would be flawless, but well, nothing ever is.

So, here’s what’s been fixed in this patch:

🛠️ Bugfixes:

  [list]
[*]   The game no longer gets stuck when talking to the inquisitor at the pub in the morning for the second time.
[*]     You can no longer use the bird feeder twice.
[*]     It's no longer possible to ring both bells on the street at the same time.
[*]     The sunflower can no longer be collected while the bell is ringing at the mill.
[*]     The inquisitor’s face now displays correctly in the evening on the street.
[*]     Fixed an issue with Czech font letters not displaying correctly.
[*]     Resolved a bug where dialogue bubbles could become smaller if clicked too quickly.
[/list]

Thanks again for spending your time in the strange little world of Hexed Time. Your support allows me to create more similar, but better games in the future!

Petra Emmer

notes.title: ⌛ Hexed Time is out! 🎉
notes.content:
Hi!!

I'm excited (and a little nervous) to announce that my game Hexed Time is officially released on Steam – and you can play it right now (and for free)!

This is my first ever release on Steam, so it means a lot to finally share it with you. Hexed Time is a small puzzle adventure I originally made during university, and I decided to give it a bit of polish and put it out into the world.

💬 I'd love to hear your feedback!
Since this is my first public release, I'm looking to learn as much as I can from it. If you encounter bugs, pacing issues, or anything that feels off – and I hope there won't be any, but fear that I couldn't fix them all – let me know! Your comments will help me improve the game and I want to roll out an update that makes it play better.

Thanks so much for checking it out. I hope you enjoy your time in this strange little world I've made 💜

Petra Emmer

notes.title: Hexed Time releases on April 15th!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

I'm thrilled to announce that Hexed Time will officially release on April 15th here on Steam!

The game originally started as a university project — just a small idea brought to life during my studies. I, along with many other players, enjoyed the concept, so it was only a matter of time before I smoothed out the edges and published it as a full game.

Hexed Time is a hand-drawn point-and-click puzzle adventure about a witch trapped in a time loop, trying to change fate without getting caught by the Inquisition. It’s a story about choices, consequences, and a little bit of magic.

I would love to invite all of you to play it, experience Amelia’s story, and see where your choices lead. Thank you so much for your support — it means the world to me.

Stay tuned for the launch — I can't wait to hear what you think of the game!

[b]Petra Emmer[/b]
